evidence.reason: The denylist workflow runs gitleaks v8.30.1 with only `--config`, so the tool also loads a source-local `.gitleaksignore` from the checked-out PR head. A PR can therefore add a prohibited value plus its fingerprint in `.gitleaksignore` and pass the required fail-closed denylist check without altering the trusted TOML. The finding correctly identifies the bypass at the scan invocation; the fix belongs in the workflow template and re-instantiation.
